show.title: Chai & Love
show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/5BpqUQ
show.description: A billionaire CEO hides behind the mask of a humble chaiwala to win the heart of the woman he has loved since his teenage years. When Shruti runs away from a forced marriage, fate throws her into Dharam’s arms—sparking a contract marriage built on lies, laughter, and unexpected love. As class clashes, family drama, and buried truths surface, Dharam must choose between protecting his secret and risking everything for honest love
